# Chilled goods ship on Mondays only

## Decision Question

How often do chilled lines go out?

## Decision Outcome

Chilled goods ship on Mondays only, in the one refrigerated van.

## Alternatives Considered

- Hiring a second refrigerated van, ruled out on cost.

## Approved By

Hal Brennan, at the 2026-05-14 carrier review.
